summary: AI-powered web scraping and browser automation tools have undergone a major transformation by 2026, with LLM-native extraction, natural language queries, and agentic browser control becoming standard features rather than differentiators. The ecosystem has split into three distinct tiers: developer-focused APIs returning LLM-ready markdown (Firecrawl, CrawlForge), managed cloud browser infrastructure for complex JavaScript-heavy sites (Browserbase, Browserless), and no-code platforms democratizing scraping for non-technical users (Browse AI, Octoparse). MCP-native tooling and AI agent compatibility with systems like Claude and Cursor are emerging as the defining adoption drivers for 2026.
